Name: Artifact Spot Duggy
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
Have you ever been frustrated that the artifact spots (aka wiggly worms) are just too invisible? Do the duggies that pop out of the dirt fill you with a compulsion to hit their smug little faces? If so, this mod is for you!

[u]What does this mod do?[/u]
This mod replaces the artifact spot with a green duggy (the monster that pops its head out of the dirt). That is all! It's a very simple mod.


[u]Is this mod compatible with recolors?[/u]
I have not tested with any recolors. It should work just fine, though it is possible it would look funny. If the recolor also recolors the artifact spot, it might conflict.
